The P SSY is optimized for yodeling, applying controlled yodisation and related phonetic modifications to enhance realism, smooth transitions between sounds, and produce more natural-sounding, yodel-like simulated speech. In specific applications it is being used to  simulate sophisticated sheep noises, from gentle bleats to full-on baaing.
